verdict.rationale: Delaware's online filing and tax portals are web services that could plausibly track usage, so the opt-out axis applies. The evidence pack covers formation, filing, fees, CAPTCHA and missing crawl/API files, but says nothing about telemetry, analytics, cookies, or any opt-out control. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
